name: Singapore City & Southern Ridges
imageAlt: image of Singapore City & Southern Ridges
summary: Spend four days exploring Singapore's hawker centres, historic districts and leafy Southern Ridges walking trails.

name: Mount Roraima Trek
summary: Join a guided eight-day expedition across the Gran Sabana to the summit plateau of Mount Roraima, with staffed camps along the route.

name: Socotra Island Expedition
summary: Explore Socotra's dragon blood trees, limestone caves and remote beaches on a locally guided week-long island circuit.

name: Lake Baikal Winter Journey
imageAlt: image of Lake Baikal Winter Journey
summary: A ten-day small-group winter itinerary with an experienced local guide, frozen-lake viewpoints and stays in Irkutsk and Listvyanka.

name: Anse Source d’Argent Escape
imageAlt: image of Anse Source d’Argent Escape
summary: Unhurried days on La Digue with bicycle hire, a guided coastal walk and time to swim at Anse Source d’Argent.

name: Aysén Patagonia Wilderness
summary: Follow a seven-day road itinerary along the Carretera Austral, with lodge stays, short guided hikes and time beside General Carrera Lake.

name: Taman Negara Rainforest Trail
imageAlt: image of Taman Negara Rainforest Trail
summary: Spend four days in Malaysia's rainforest with a licensed naturalist, including a canopy walkway visit and a river journey to a village.

name: Zhangye Danxia Geopark
summary: A five-day guided visit to Zhangye Danxia's colourful sandstone formations, with a local driver and two nights near the geopark.

name: 5-Day Japan Highlights: Culture, Food and Adventure
imageAlt: image of Tokyo, Hakone, Kyoto and Osaka highlights on a five-day Japan itinerary
summary: Experience Japan in five days, from Tokyo's neighbourhoods and Kyoto's historic temples to Osaka's lively food scene. Travel between cities by Shinkansen and unwind with an optional Hakone onsen visit.
subtitle: Luxury, Diversity, and Harmony

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo and Shibuya
activities: Arrive at Narita or Haneda Airport and check in to your hotel.
Visit Shibuya Crossing and the Hachiko statue.
See the city from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building.
Have dinner at an izakaya in Golden Gai.

itinerary.title: Tokyo sightseeing and culture
activities: Explore Akihabara's electronics and anime shops.
Walk around Tokyo Tower and Roppongi in the evening.

itinerary.title: Hakone and views of Mount Fuji
activities: Ride the Hakone Ropeway for views across the area.
Relax at an onsen hot spring.
Visit Lake Ashi and look for Mount Fuji on a clear day.

itinerary.title: Kyoto temples and history
activities: Travel to Kyoto by Shinkansen bullet train.
Walk through the torii gates at Fushimi Inari Shrine.
Explore the Gion district in the evening.

itinerary.title: Osaka shopping and departure
activities: Travel from Kyoto to Osaka and leave your luggage at the hotel.
Explore the shops and food stalls around Shinsaibashi.
Travel to Kansai International Airport (KIX) for your departure.

bestTimeToVisit.description: Autumn leaves and comfortable walking weather.
Quieter temples and possible snow in Kyoto.
Hot, humid days and seasonal festivals.
